meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装上个人微信频道：从 channels 分支拷入微信适配器、安装 wechat-ilink-client、扫码登录。消息通过长轮询实时接收，不需要 webhook 地址，也不需要付费 token。
howto.when: 当你要求把个人微信接入 NanoClaw、需要微信扫码登录，或要把微信消息接到某个 agent group 时接管。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会拷入适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 把微信消息接到 ag-xxxx 这个 agent group
say.note: 运行 wire-dm.ts 建立接线

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. It copies the WeChat adapter in, installs wechat-ilink-client, and logs in by QR scan; messages arrive over long-poll — no webhook or paid token.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a personal WeChat channel, scan a WeChat login QR code, or wire incoming WeChat messages to an agent group.

say_en.text: Add my personal WeChat as a channel in NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs the test

say_en.text: Where's the WeChat login QR code?
say_en.note: The QR URL is logged and saved to data/wechat/qr.txt

say_en.text: Wire WeChat messages to agent group ag-xxxx
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts to create the wiring
